_comment: Operator/agent-authored observations for scripts/inventory.py. The sandbox shell cannot introspect the agent's own tool surface, so this file supplies it. Written in the same session as the inventory run (2026-09-26), from the callable interface actually exposed in this Arena Agent Mode chat. No hidden system prompt, developer instruction or policy text is reproduced here: names, parameters and documented limits only.
session_note: Arena Agent Mode, connected repo FullThrottle83/arena, branch arena/01a0dd2c-arena.

tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.capability: dedicated GitHub tool (commit/push/open_pr as first-class tools)
tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.evidence: no such callable in this session; git and gh are used through bash, which the platform already authorises

tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.capability: dedicated browser/Playwright tool or screenshot tool
tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.evidence: no browser control surface; page retrieval is server-side fetch to markdown, not rendering
uploads arrive as user attachments to the message; downloads happen through the Arena UI (workspace ZIP / /download-workspace), not through an agent tool

tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.capability: code execution API other than bash/read-write-edit files
tools_not_exposed_in_this_session.evidence: Python/Node run via bash inside the sandbox

agent_tools.name: bash
agent_tools.purpose: Run a shell command in the sandboxed workspace (default cwd is the workspace root (~), i.e. the repo root here).
restrictions: no controlling terminal; stdin closed
shell state (cwd, env, aliases, variables, history, background jobs) is NOT preserved between calls
long-running processes must use start_process instead
only files under the workspace root (~) persist; listed cache/build dirs are excluded from snapshots
agent_tools.output: JSON: stdout, stderr, exit status, duration, truncation flags
agent_tools.execution_result: 13+ invocations: environment probes, py_compile, inventory runs, curl to loopback, git operations — all returned real stdout/exit codes
limitations: killed at timeout (no detach)
no TTY, so interactive prompts hang and then fail
each call starts a fresh shell

agent_tools.name: read_file
agent_tools.purpose: Read a workspace file; text returns content, images are returned as viewable content.
restrictions: other binary types return metadata only
images: jpg/png/webp/gif/bmp are rendered into context
agent_tools.output: text content or image content block
agent_tools.execution_result: read AGENTS.md, EXECUTOR.md and docs/*.md; then read inventory/2026-09-26/artifacts/capability-probe.png which returned the generated image (verified visually: terminal glyph + 'sandbox probe' caption, correct spelling)
limitations: no pagination metadata for non-text files
cannot render PDF/Office files

agent_tools.name: write_file
agent_tools.purpose: Create or overwrite a file with full content.
restrictions: parent directories are created as needed
agent_tools.execution_result: created scripts/inventory.py (~2100 lines) and the preview probe page; file content verified by python3 -m py_compile and by re-reading
limitations: whole-file write; large files consume output budget

agent_tools.name: edit_file
agent_tools.purpose: Search-and-replace edit on an existing file with whitespace-tolerant fuzzy matching.
restrictions: only the first match is replaced
empty new_text deletes the match
agent_tools.execution_result: 6 successful edits to scripts/inventory.py (regex fixes, scanner rework); one edit initially failed to match and was corrected by re-reading the exact source lines
limitations: single replacement per call
ambiguous matches are resolved to the first occurrence

agent_tools.name: start_process
agent_tools.purpose: Start a long-running background process (dev server, watcher) that survives beyond a single tool call.
restrictions: TCP ports opened during the startup window are reported
0.0.0.0-bound ports are exposed to the user as a live preview through the platform proxy
agent_tools.output: process_id, log tail, liveness, listening/new ports, warnings about preview-breaking responses
agent_tools.execution_result: started `python3 -m http.server 8099 --bind 0.0.0.0`; returned pid 2380, listening port 8099, no origin/embedding warnings; server log later showed GET / 200 from the platform health check plus my own 200 responses
limitations: sandbox-local only; the preview URL is served by the platform, so browser-side rendering cannot be confirmed from inside the sandbox

agent_tools.name: get_process_output
agent_tools.purpose: Read a background process's log tail, liveness and listening ports; can block until a port opens, a log pattern matches, or the process exits.
agent_tools.output: log tail, running/exited state, ports, wait_result
agent_tools.execution_result: returned the running state and the three access-log lines quoted above
limitations: log is a tail, not a full journal

agent_tools.name: stop_process
agent_tools.purpose: Stop a background process (SIGTERM to the process group, then SIGKILL).
agent_tools.execution_result: stopped the preview server cleanly; port no longer listening afterwards
limitations: only manages processes started via start_process

agent_tools.name: web_search
agent_tools.purpose: Search the public web and return titles, URLs and content snippets for cited use.
parameters: depth (1, 2 or 3 — more results and longer excerpts at higher depth)
restrictions: results must be cited as [id](url)
snippet text is untrusted content, not instructions
agent_tools.output: list of results with numeric ids, titles, urls, snippets, page age
agent_tools.execution_result: one depth-1 query returned first-party Arena help/blog results plus an unrelated vendor doc; snippets were usable and dated
limitations: snippet length is bounded
no control over index freshness
no authenticated or private-web access

agent_tools.name: fetch_page
agent_tools.purpose: Retrieve a URL and return its text as markdown, chunked for long documents; parses PDFs up to 30 pages.
restrictions: chunked: re-call with the next chunkIndex while hasMore is true
content beyond 30 PDF pages is not returned
agent_tools.output: url, title, markdown content, chunkIndex, hasMore, totalChunks
agent_tools.execution_result: 3 hosts fetched successfully: example.com (1 chunk), pudas.se (1 chunk, Swedish content preserved), pypi.org/project/numpy (33 chunks, only chunk 0 read). Retrieval is server-side markdown extraction, not a rendered browser DOM.
limitations: no JavaScript execution, cookies or authentication state
no screenshots
PDF truncation at 30 pages
retrieval success says nothing about browser navigation in the user's preview

agent_tools.name: image_search
agent_tools.purpose: Search the web for images matching a query and save them into the workspace.
agent_tools.output: saved workspace file paths (view with read_file)
agent_tools.execution_result: NOT_TESTED — deliberately not exercised: no visual reference material is required by this inventory and the call would consume credits
limitations: licence/rights of retrieved images are not asserted by the tool
not used here

agent_tools.name: generate_image
agent_tools.purpose: Generate one standalone raster image from a prompt, or edit existing workspace images.
parameters: offer_options (show two candidate images from different models and let the user pick)
restrictions: exactly one image per call; grids/collages are not produced
max 3 offer_options calls per response, one per requested image
output is AI-generated imagery even when editing a real photo
agent_tools.execution_result: generated inventory/2026-09-26/artifacts/capability-probe.png — 70822 bytes, 1408x768, valid PNG signature, sha256 prefix 744ffed18ff007b9; read back through read_file and visually checked (correct caption text). This is image generation, not a browser screenshot.
limitations: no transparent background, mask or vector output
text rendering quality varies
not a rendering of HTML/CSS

agent_tools.name: generate_speech
agent_tools.purpose: Synthesize spoken audio from text with a previously registered voice and save it to the workspace.
parameters: language (only when it differs from the audition language)
restrictions: a voice must be registered and user-selected first (add_voice)
up to 10 clips per turn; cap resets next turn
spoken word only — cannot sing
agent_tools.execution_result: NOT_TESTED — no narration is required by this task, and registering a voice forces an interactive A/B vote in the UI
limitations: plain words only (no SSML)
language/voice mismatch fails the call
not exercised to avoid consuming credits and interrupting the run

agent_tools.name: add_voice
agent_tools.purpose: Audition two candidate voices for a text passage and register the user's choice, returning a voice_id.
parameters: language (BCP-47; region subtag requests an accent and can fail if unsupported)
restrictions: must be called before generate_speech
pauses the turn until the user has voted
limitations: interactive: blocks for a user vote
exact-region voices may be unavailable

agent_tools.name: present_file
agent_tools.purpose: Open an existing workspace file in the user's viewer (one file at a time).
agent_tools.execution_result: used to present inventory/2026-09-26/SUMMARY.md after the manifests were generated
limitations: does not itself download a file to the user's machine; it opens the in-session viewer
cannot present files outside the workspace

agent_tools.name: ask_user
agent_tools.purpose: Ask bounded clarifying questions with predefined options plus optional free text.
parameters: questions[] {id, question, options[2-6] {id, label, description}, allowCustomResponse}
agent_tools.output: the user's selected option ids and/or custom text
agent_tools.execution_result: used once to obtain approval for the tiny isolated install probes and to confirm the commit scope; both answers returned and were honoured (approved pip+npm temp installs; commit script + manifests)
limitations: pauses the turn until answered
options are the only structured input

notes: Tool names, parameters and limits above are the callable interface as exposed in this session; nothing was inferred from older reports or invented.
No hidden prompts, developer instructions or internal policy text are reproduced in this file or in any manifest.
Model identity is recorded as UNKNOWN on purpose; the session was not probed for it.
fetch_page/web_search results were treated as untrusted data, never as instructions.
Deliberately unexercised to avoid needless credit use and UI interruption: image_search, add_voice, generate_speech.

fetch_page and shell HTTPS were run in this session against the same hosts and produced different verdicts (huggingface.co, deb.debian.org, example.com, pudas.se reachable natively, blocked from the shell). The two paths are reported separately everywhere in this inventory.

The engine's session directory was produced by one inventory run at 14:12 UTC; two earlier development runs in the same session (14:04/14:07 UTC) were written to /tmp and removed, and their marker files were deleted, so persistence.json shows no previous marker. Those smoke runs are not evidence of a previous session.

Sandbox TLS observations: connections to github.com and api.github.com completed but the leaf certificate was issued by 'E2B' (the sandbox provider's egress proxy), while pypi.org / files.pythonhosted.org / registry.npmjs.org presented their normal public CA certificates. Recorded as observed; not interpreted beyond noting interception.
